title: Punto 4 — Validación ejecutable inicial D35/D36

execution.workflow: Validate Three.js Manifest — Math and CPU

records.name: PID controller
records.test_name: D35:0 PID controller — proportional step and output saturation
records.coverage_limit: Proportional term and output clipping only; integral anti-windup dynamics not fully exercised.

records.name: Proportional tracking
records.test_name: D35:1 proportional tracking — equilibrium and bounded Euler step
records.coverage_limit: Equilibrium and one scalar Euler step; vector convergence envelope remains to test.

records.name: Critically damped spring
records.test_name: D35:2 critically damped spring — acceleration and state step
records.coverage_limit: One semi-implicit step; long-horizon stability and convergence remain to test.

records.name: Kalman state model
records.test_name: D35:3 Kalman state model — scalar prediction and correction
records.coverage_limit: Scalar covariance update; matrix PSD and observability cases remain to test.

records.name: Gradient descent
records.test_name: D35:4 gradient descent — quadratic objective decreases
records.coverage_limit: One convex quadratic step; line search and non-convex stopping remain to test.

records.name: Levenberg–Marquardt
records.test_name: D35:5 Levenberg–Marquardt — damped scalar normal equation
records.coverage_limit: Scalar damped normal equation; rank-deficient and gain-ratio acceptance remain to test.

records.name: Newton method
records.test_name: D35:6 Newton method — square-root convergence
records.coverage_limit: Scalar simple-root convergence and derivative-free failure path not yet tested.

records.name: Bisection
records.test_name: D35:7 bisection — bracket contracts around sqrt(2)
records.coverage_limit: Deterministic bracket contraction; pathological floating-point endpoints remain to test.

records.name: Cubic interpolation
records.test_name: D35:8 cubic interpolation — Hermite endpoints and tangents
records.coverage_limit: Endpoint and tangent constraints; multi-segment continuity remains to test.

records.name: Fourier series
records.test_name: D35:9 Fourier series — constant and single sine reconstruction
records.coverage_limit: Constant and single harmonic only; general coefficient reconstruction remains to test.

records.name: FFT
records.test_name: D35:10 FFT — DFT impulse and inverse round trip
records.coverage_limit: Naive DFT reference; optimized FFT complexity and Parseval suite remain to test.

records.name: Wavelet transform
records.test_name: D35:11 wavelet transform — Haar transform annihilates constant details
records.coverage_limit: Haar constant-signal detail coefficients; reconstruction and scale normalization remain to test.

records.name: Monte Carlo sampling
records.test_name: D35:12 Monte Carlo — deterministic sample mean estimates expectation
records.coverage_limit: Fixed deterministic sample mean; confidence coverage and statistical convergence remain to test.

records.name: Blue-noise sampling
records.test_name: D35:13 blue-noise sampling — rejection sampler preserves minimum spacing
records.coverage_limit: Hard-core spacing/domain invariant only; blue-noise spectral quality is not tested.

records.name: Integración volumétrica Beer–Lambert
records.test_name: D35:14 Beer–Lambert — homogeneous medium transmittance
records.coverage_limit: Homogeneous transmittance; in-scattering quadrature and step refinement remain to test.

records.name: Derivada material
records.test_name: D36:0 material derivative — chain rule along moving particle
records.coverage_limit: Analytic scalar chain-rule point; field discretization and interpolation remain to test.

records.name: Euler explícito
records.test_name: D36:1 explicit Euler — first-order scalar step
records.coverage_limit: One scalar step; order/stability sweep remains to test.

records.name: Runge–Kutta de cuarto orden
records.test_name: D36:2 RK4 — fourth-order step for exponential decay
records.coverage_limit: One canonical decay step; convergence-order study remains to test.

records.name: Integrador Verlet
records.test_name: D36:3 Verlet — harmonic oscillator recurrence
records.coverage_limit: One recurrence step; long-term energy behavior remains to test.

records.name: CFL condition
records.test_name: D36:4 CFL — Courant number and admissible timestep
records.coverage_limit: Scalar admissibility check; multi-dimensional wave speeds remain to test.

records.name: Poisson equation
records.test_name: D36:5 Poisson — discrete 1D Dirichlet solution satisfies stencil
records.coverage_limit: Exact discrete stencil residual; general boundary handling and solver convergence remain to test.

records.name: Conjugate gradient
records.test_name: D36:6 conjugate gradient — SPD system reaches exact solution
records.coverage_limit: Two-dimensional SPD system; ill-conditioning and breakdown cases remain to test.

records.name: Multigrid
records.test_name: D36:7 multigrid transfers — restriction and prolongation preserve constants
records.coverage_limit: Transfer invariance only; complete V-cycle convergence is not tested.

records.name: Método de volúmenes finitos
records.test_name: D36:8 finite volumes — shared face flux cancels globally
records.coverage_limit: Global shared-face flux accounting; numerical flux stability and consistency remain to test.

records.name: Método de elementos finitos
records.test_name: D36:9 finite elements — linear bar stiffness and displacement
records.coverage_limit: Single linear bar closed form; mesh convergence and assembly generality remain to test.

records.name: Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics completo
records.test_name: D36:10 SPH — normalized particle sum reproduces constant field
records.coverage_limit: Constant-field particle sum; boundary correction and dynamic equations remain to test.

records.name: Ecuación de elasticidad de Cauchy
records.test_name: D36:11 Cauchy elasticity — momentum balance returns acceleration
records.coverage_limit: Scalar momentum balance; tensor constitutive and boundary problems remain to test.

records.name: Viscoelasticidad Kelvin–Voigt
records.test_name: D36:12 Kelvin–Voigt — elastic and viscous stress contributions add
records.coverage_limit: Constitutive stress sum; time-dependent relaxation response remains to test.

records.name: Plasticidad J2 von Mises
records.test_name: D36:13 J2 von Mises — deviatoric stress equivalent and yield check
records.coverage_limit: Equivalent stress/yield condition only; return mapping and plastic strain evolution remain to test.

records.name: Difusión anisotrópica
records.test_name: D36:14 anisotropic diffusion — tensor-weighted Laplacian
records.coverage_limit: Constant diagonal tensor and quadratic field; variable tensor discretization remains to test.

global_limitations: La suite ejecuta oráculos numéricos de referencia, no llama todavía a implementaciones de producción de las 30 técnicas.
No se ha ejecutado un navegador real; el workflow actual corre pruebas Node.js CPU y un smoke test de BufferGeometry.
Las coberturas parciales indicadas por técnica deben ampliarse antes de certificación.
La certificación independiente de las derivaciones y la trazabilidad desde el algoritmo hasta la implementación siguen pendientes.
La contingencia de buscar e integrar una implementación empírica externa se activará solo ante un fallo reproducible; en esta ejecución no hubo fallo de pruebas.
result: 30/30 pruebas de referencia aprobadas; esto demuestra consistencia de casos numéricos básicos, no certificación final de implementación.
